node.statement: By node 1.1.2, G=(f_ab)_{a,b in S} is row-stochastic, and by node 1.2.2, q_a=0 for every a outside S. Hence for each b in S, (q_S G)_b=sum_{a in S} q_a f_ab=sum_{a=1}^n q_a f_ab=(qF)_b=q_b=(q_S)_b, where the penultimate equality uses node 1.2.3.1. Therefore q_S G=q_S.
